fighter_pools._doc: Combat Formulas A, a Character's fighter pools: n = clamp(stat / ref[r], n_min, n_max), stat being the Character's vitality_max and spiritual_power before their pct bonuses (the build-file path adds those). ref[r] is the stat of a talent-ref_talent, stage-1.00, no-bonus character: body ref_talent x khi_huyet_per_can_cot x the realm's khi_huyet_mult, linh luc the realm's linh_luc_base x ref_tech_power.

fighter_gear._doc: Combat Defence & Healing Formulas A0 and A2, a Character's defence from worn gear. a_w = defence of artifacts without the body_gear role / (power_base x stage_mult); a_b = the same for body_gear pieces. Ward strength and efficiency start at 100 x ward_gear_scale x a_w (the sheet's defense_pct and ward_efficiency_pct lines add on top); ward layer W3 = 100 x layer_gear_scale x a_w and body layer B3 = 100 x layer_gear_scale x a_b; block = flesh_block x n_body + gear_block x min(a_w, 1), body block gear_block x a_b (scaled by the body layers). Typical gear (a_w 0.85) reproduces the typical anchor: ws_base 25.5 of 30.8, W3 +40, block 15.0.

fight_engine._doc: ADR-0001 step 4 feature flag: when enabled, an event's combat check runs a real fight (CombatService, both sides compiled by FighterCompiler.compile, the seed one draw from the session stream per ADR-0002) instead of the duel roll; a side that cannot compile falls back to the duel, and the check line says why. Off until the fights are signed off in play. odds_samples: how many fights the event card's odds are estimated from (seeded from a keyed stream on the two fighters, so the session stream never moves and the card is stable).
